source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the phase of AC (PDF 90-92).

blocks.text: Woh zawiya theta jo alternating voltage ya current ki lamhati qeemat batata hai phase kehlata hai. V = Vo sin(wt) = Vo sin(theta) aur I = Io sin(wt) = Io sin(theta) ke saath aik chakkar ke nuqton A, B, C, D aur E ke phase 0, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi hain (Fig 17.5 a): AC chakkar ka har nuqta aik phase se mutabiqat rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: +Vo aur -Vo ke darmiyan alternating voltage ka aik sabz chakkar. Mehwar theta = omega t par nuqte A, B, C, D aur E phases 0, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi par hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (a): AC chakkar ka har nuqta aik phase hai (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 17.5 (a) ke mehwar par '2 theta = omega t' chhapa hai; durust theta = omega t hai (matan bhi yahi kehta hai). Har nuqta A se E tak chakkar ka aik phase hai: A = 0, B = pi/2 (chotti), C = pi, D = 3 pi/2 (garha), E = 2 pi.

t = 0 par theta ki qeemat initial phase hai. V = Vo sin(theta) aur I = Io sin(theta) (17.9) ke saath voltage aur current dono ka initial phase sifar hai aur woh in phase hain. Aksar aisa nahi hota. Agar V = Vo sin(theta) aur I = Io sin(theta + phi) ho to t = 0 par voltage sifar lekin current pehle se musbat (Io sin phi) hai: current phi zawiye pehle sifar par pohancha, is liye current voltage se phi aage (lead) hai (Fig 17.5 b). Agar I = Io sin(theta - phi) ho to current phi baad sifar par pohanchta aur voltage se peeche (lag) hai (Fig 17.5 c). Zawiya phi V aur I ka phase farq hai.

blocks.alt: t ke muqable do graph. (b) Positive phase: surkh current I = Io sin(theta + phi) t = 0 se phi pehle shuru hota, t = 0 par Io sin phi hai aur sabz voltage V se pehle +Io par pohanchta hai. (c) Negative phase: current I = Io sin(theta - phi) t = 0 par -Io sin phi hai aur V ke phi baad sifar paar karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (b), (c): (b) current voltage se aage, (c) current voltage se peeche (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (b), (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab t = 0 par current ki qeemat 'Io sin theta' likhti hai. t = 0 par theta = 0 hai, is liye durust qeemat (b) mein Io sin phi aur (c) mein -Io sin phi hai; khaake mein yahi likha hai. Jo lehar apni chotti par pehle pohanche woh aage (lead) hai.

items: Ghoomte vector ki lambai kisi paimane par alternating miqdar ki peak ya rms qeemat dikhati hai.
Jis lamhe miqdar sifar ho aur musbat taraf barh rahi ho, vector ufqi hota hai.
Vector alternating miqdar ki angular frequency se anticlockwise ghoomta hai.

blocks.text: Fig 17.5 (d) voltage ki wave ko current ki wave se 90 darje (pi/2 rad) aage dikhati hai. Fig 17.5 (e) mein vector OI current, jo hawala hai, aur OV voltage dikhata hai jo 90 darje aage hai; dono vectors angular frequency se anticlockwise ghoomte hain.

blocks.alt: (d) Surkh voltage V aur sabz current I waqt ke saath; V apni chotti par I se chauthai chakkar, pi/2, pehle pohanchta hai. (e) O se vector diagram: OI ufqi (current) aur OV amudi (voltage), darmiyan 90 darje ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (d), (e): (d) voltage V current I se pi/2 aage; (e) vector diagram OI aur OV, V aage 90 darje (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (d), (e) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Agar I = Io sin(wt + pi/2) aur V = Vo sin(wt) ho to kaun aage hai, aur kitna?
blocks.explanation: Current voltage se pi/2 (90 darje) aage hai.

items: Phase theta = wt lamhati halat batata.
I = Io sin(theta + phi): current aage; I = Io sin(theta - phi): current peeche.
Phasors: w par anticlockwise ghoomte vectors.
